title: Fractions and decimals
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.dec.convert.to-decimal: Make the bottom 10, 100 or 1000 by multiplying the top and bottom by the same number. Then write it as tenths, hundredths or thousandths.
hints.dec.convert.to-fraction: Count the places after the point: 1 place is tenths, 2 hundredths, 3 thousandths. Write it over 10, 100 or 1000, then simplify.
hints.dec.convert: Fraction to decimal: make the bottom 10, 100 or 1000. Decimal to fraction: write it over 10, 100 or 1000 and simplify.

misconceptionMessages.dec.convert-digits: The digits of the fraction aren't the decimal. Make the bottom 10, 100 or 1000 first: 3/4 = 75/100 = 0.75.
misconceptionMessages.dec.convert-flipped: A fraction is the top divided by the bottom, not the other way round. 4/5 is less than 1, so its decimal is less than 1.
misconceptionMessages.dec.convert-over-ten: Count the places: 0.35 has 2 places, so it's 35 hundredths: 35/100. Then simplify.

similarProblemIntro: Here's the worked solution. Now try one like it.

sections.title: Fraction to decimal
sections.objective: Write fractions like 3/4 and 3/8 as decimals.
explain: Find a number to multiply the bottom by to get 10, 100 or 1000. Multiply the top by the same number.
Halves, fifths and tenths go to 10; quarters, twentieths and 25ths to 100; eighths to 1000.
sections.key: Make the bottom 10, 100 or 1000 (same number times the top and the bottom). Then read it as tenths, hundredths or thousandths.

worked.note: multiply the top and bottom by 25

sections.title: Decimal to fraction
sections.objective: Write decimals as fractions in simplest form.
explain: Read the decimal: 0.35 is 35 hundredths. Write that as a fraction.
sections.key: Count the places: 1 place is tenths, 2 hundredths, 3 thousandths. Write the digits over 10, 100 or 1000, then simplify.

worked.note: divide the top and bottom by 5

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Fractions to decimals and decimals to fractions, mixed.
sections.key: Fraction to decimal: bottom to 10, 100 or 1000. Decimal to fraction: over 10, 100 or 1000, then simplify.
